title: Dino Island Expedition
tagline: A fossil-hunting expedition on a lost island
description: Original expedition adventure: the learner joins a fossil-hunting team on a newly risen lost island, cataloguing wonders and surviving hazards with science. For learners who love dinosaurs, discovery, and dig sites.
worldPrompt: An original expedition adventure as the newest member of a fossil-hunting team on Kaia Island, newly risen from the sea. Each subject unit is an expedition zone with discoveries to catalogue and hazards to out-think. Original creatures, field journal entries, and a rival expedition team.
